_doc: Defence factors per weapon class, in percent (100 = normal). Mirrors .tmp.combat.wtf in dreamland_fenia utils/combat. Fenia does not read it yet (a change there must be made in both until it does). The gear sage (characterwrapper.cpp ga_offhandModel) reads it through weapon_defense_factor(), and a Fenia reader must skip this _doc key. Class = the weapon class name, unarmed = no weapon (or an unknown class). AGAINST this weapon: disarm, parry, dodge, blink (blink), swarm (bat swarm), shield (shield block), hand (hand block). WITH this weapon: disarm_with, parry_with. Staff grip (a staff wielded with shield, hold and second_wield all empty): parry_with_grip replaces parry_with, disarm_grip replaces disarm. A missing class takes the unarmed row (both readers). A missing key reads as 0 in Fenia (the skill is impossible) and as the caller default in the sage. 0 = cannot be done at all. Keep it in step with weapon_classes.json class names, but never add a key there for this table.
